p: Barking Road is the long main road running through Plaistow and on towards East Ham, and MERKUR at 368-370 is on a busy stretch of local shops, takeaways and cafés. Plaistow station on the District and Hammersmith & City lines is close by, and buses run up and down the road all day. Strictly adults: it's 18+.

This is West Ham country. The old Boleyn Ground, their home for over a century, stood on Green Street just off Barking Road at Upton Park, though it's now housing since the club moved to the London Stadium. Queen's Market on Green Street is a lively spot for food and bargains.
